disclaimer: Reference compilation only – NOT for navigation. Always verify with current official AIPs, NOTAMs, and certified FMS/nav database before flight.
sourceDoc: NAT_HLA_Waypoints_Reference.md + NAT_HLA_Named_Waypoints_Sample.md + OpenNav + TC AIM NAT

priority: Transport Canada AIM NAT Table 1.1 (Gander 050°W OEPs)
Transport Canada AIM NAT explicit coordinates (e.g. LIBOR 6101N06241W)
AirNav Ireland AIP ENR 4.4 (oceanic entry/exit points)
FAA NFDC Location ID — Fixes/Waypoints (official US / many oceanic fixes)
Manual Teach (user) — never overwritten by online lookup
coordinateSources.note: Eurocontrol EAD (EASA-certified AIS) requires registration; not used for automated bulk download. Official AIM/AIP/FAA overrule OpenNav. FAA LID coordinates for Gander 050°W OEP names disagree with TC AIM Table 1.1 — AIM wins for those OEPs.
